title: Tea, iced, brewed, black, decaffeinated, unsweetened

content.title: About
content.content: Iced, brewed, black, decaffeinated, unsweetened tea is a refreshing beverage made from black tea leaves that are first brewed and then chilled. The caffeine is removed and no sugar is added, making it low‑calorie and suitable for those avoiding stimulants and sweeteners.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is the world’s second most consumed beverage after water.
Cold‑brew retains many of the antioxidants found in hot‑brew tea.
Decaffeination is usually done by water or CO₂ processes, preserving leaf flavor.
Without sugar, the tea has a naturally slightly bitter taste that becomes more pronounced when chilled.
In some cultures, iced black tea is served with a slice of lemon or mint for extra aroma.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Black tea contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Regular tea consumption may help lower cholesterol levels and improve vessel function.

items.title: Improves hydration
items.content: Unsweetened iced tea is a tasty way to increase fluid intake, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: The absence of sugar and caffeine makes this drink virtually calorie‑free, useful for weight management.

items.title: Stress reduction
items.content: L‑theanine in tea can promote relaxation without causing drowsiness.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Iron absorption
items.content: Tannins can reduce iron absorption from meals, so it’s best not to drink tea with main meals.

items.title: Fluoride content
items.content: Excessive consumption may lead to fluoride buildup, which can affect dental health.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the iced tea on its own, or add a slice of lemon, mint leaves, or berries for extra flavor. It also works well as a base for non‑alcoholic cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared beverage in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑5 days. Discard if it becomes cloudy, develops an off‑smell, or changes taste.
